  reg [2:0] counter; 
  initial counter = 0; 
  assign ceout = ceoutmux;

  counter <= counter + 1; 
  end 
  always @(*) begin 
  case(divisor) 
  2'b00: 
  ceoutmux <= cein; 
  2'b01: 
  ceoutmux <= cein & counter[0]; 
  2'b10: 
  ceoutmux <= cein & counter[0] & counter[1]; 
  2'b11: 
  ceoutmux <= cein & counter[0] & counter[1] & counter[2]; 
  default: 
  ceoutmux <= 1'bx; 
  endcase 
  end
